title: Chapter 730
text:
Molding Talents were hard to come by, and Han Xiao had obtained all of them through unconventional means.

Although the [Prey] mission was a good opportunity to obtain talents, Thousand Shadows had not triggered the next round after so long, and he almost thought that Thousand Shadows had given up. However, the mission had not been completed, and he did not know what was going on.

In his memory, the missions that rewarded talents were mostly normal talents, and there were very few rare ones. He had to consider which missions to complete.

The missions that were not in the Shattered Star Ring were eliminated first.

Some of the talents had a limited increase in combat strength and would only waste time. These were also eliminated.

After filtering through, Han Xiao chose a few missions that were relatively more cost-effective.

Although the rewarded talents could not change his combat strength drastically like Molding Talents, they would still increase his combat strength to a certain extent.

It will take a few months to complete these missions. The war won't end so soon, so I still have plenty of time … Han Xiao thought to himself.

His current level was 221, and he would need to undergo Class Advancement at level 225. He had accumulated a few Mission Completion Cards during the version update, and he had used one at level 220. He still had some left, so he only lacked experience.

The experience required to level up after level 220 would soar, but with the harvest of the two leek fields, it would only take a few months to gather enough experience.

He could complete missions while waiting for his experience to fill up.

Han Xiao called Hella, Aurora, and Fu Ding over and explained the upcoming itinerary. The three of them had no objections.

"Oh, right." Han Xiao suddenly thought of something and said to Aurora, "Help me make some recovery potions. I want to give them to the senior officers of the army. They might be able to save their lives at a critical moment."

The Bloodshed Land was starting to make waves. In order to prevent casualties among the upper echelons of the army, he wanted to provide some life insurance for the senior officers. Aurora's life force potion had a miraculous effect, which was equivalent to a second life.

Aurora could now freely control her Esper Ability, so making potions would not consume much energy for her.

"No problem!"

Aurora was very happy.

She could finally help!

Hella originally wanted to stop her, but seeing how happy Aurora was, she decided to acquiesce.

Since it was Han Xiao's request and it wasn't too much, she just let Aurora do as she pleased. She had seen Aurora's growth, and her desire to protect her was not as extreme as before.

After spending a day settling the trivial matters, Han Xiao led the three of them on a journey to farm for talents.

…

Three blue-black scimitar-shaped spaceships flew out of the desolate universe belt, entering the Shattered Star Ring from a remote border.

In the cockpit of the leading spaceship, Colin looked at the Milky Way outside the porthole and spat out the rotten fruit he was chewing. He revealed his sharp teeth covered in purplish-blue juice and cursed.

"Bastard who deserves to be killed. After flying for almost six years, we've finally arrived."

As he spoke, he slapped the freezer control button on the spaceship's control panel.

Chi chi —

The dozens of neatly arranged low-temperature life-support refrigerators in the cabin began to defrost. The cabin doors opened, and cold air filled the air. One by one, people of different heights and races walked out. Their bodies were naked, and their bodies were covered with scars and tattoos.

"We slept for three years? That's really long. "

"Is it time to change shifts or have we arrived?"

These people who had woken up from hibernation put on their clothes and came to the cockpit.

Colin heard the footsteps and pointed at the star map without even turning his head. "We've arrived. This is the Shattered Star Ring. If you guys haven't slept too much, quickly recover your physical state. Don't delay the mission that the boss gave us."

"Don't worry, as long as I suck some blood, I'll recover."

A pale man who was tall and thin like a bamboo pole spoke. He licked his lips and glanced at his companions with ill intentions.

"Baron Orozen, if you dare touch my men, don't blame me for throwing you off the spaceship."

"Why should I listen to you?" The pale man, Orozen, sneered. His high cheekbones made him look sinister.

"Because I'm the captain personally appointed by His Excellency EsGod. Or do you want to fight?" Colin glanced at him fiercely.

Orozen chuckled and shrugged, indicating that he was willing to compromise.

Colin snorted and said, "You'd better keep a low profile. I remember that you're a fugitive who escaped from the Shattered Star Ring. I don't want to expose myself because of your stupidity before completing the mission."

"That was a fugitive from sixty years ago. It might have been revoked long ago."

Orozen did not care.

The people on these three spaceships were all members of the Fallen Ark and were wanted by different Star Fields. They had been sent out to carry out missions in the Shattered Star Ring.

Colin, nicknamed 'Rotten Poison', was a Grade A Super and the captain of this team. He had spread plagues on many colonial planets in the Ancient Star Desert, causing more than three billion casualties. He was wanted by twenty-three Star System level civilizations and two Star Cluster level civilizations. He then joined the Fallen Ark and followed EsGod.

Orozen, who called himself 'Baron', was a member of the Longevity Blood Race and the other Grade A Super in the team. He had once roamed many Star Fields to hunt for life forms. He was extremely vicious and had a bounty on his head in all five Star Fields.

This was especially so in the Shattered Star Ring. During the celebration of a certain Star System civilization, in front of the entire audience, he chewed up a high-ranking official who was giving a speech, causing a huge commotion. After escaping from the Shattered Star Ring, he joined EsGod.

This group of people had set off six years ago and had only just arrived in the Shattered Star Ring. As fugitives, they did not dare use the Interstellar Field Stargate openly and spent most of their time in the desolate universe belt.

These three Light Marten spaceships were equipped with top-notch hyperdrive engines, specifically designed for interstellar travel. They could accelerate up to level 17.89 warp speed, and if pushed to the maximum speed in a star field, they could cross a star system in a few minutes.

Even Grade B Supers like them had to hibernate in a cryogenic cabin to withstand the powerful load of the hyperdrive hyperdrive.

Relying on this Super Warp Jump Engine, this team had spent about six years crossing multiple Star Fields from the desolate universe belt to the Shattered Star Ring without relying on stargates.

One of his subordinates asked, "Captain, which mission should we do first?"

This team had two missions to do in the Shattered Star Ring.

"Are you an idiot? Of course, we'll do the easy one first! " Colin was impatient. He casually opened a file and displayed it on the light red virtual screen.

There were two people's information on it. One was Harrofal, and the other was Han Xiao.

They were the two people who had worked together to deal with EsGod's doppelganger.

"Harrofal, Grade A Super of the Tyla Civilization, Deputy Dean of the Tyla Mechanical College … He's a researcher."

"Black Star Han Xiao, leader of the Black Star Corps, ally of the Amethyst Civilization, Beyond Grade A seed … Wow, this guy's record has been updated again. He's a powerful guy. I heard that he's one of the top Calamity Grades in the Shattered Star Ring."

Hearing this, Orozen's face was filled with disdain. He sneered and said, "Black Star? When I was in the Shattered Star Ring, I never heard of this person. He's just a newbie who appeared in recent years. "

Colin did not care and said expressionlessly, "The Shattered Star Ring is just a remote Star Field. The strength of the Supers here can't be compared to the strength of the three Star Fields in the 'Central Galaxy'."

After following EsGod in the Central Galaxy, Colin and the others did not think highly of people from a remote Star Field like the Shattered Star Ring. As the most ferocious thugs in the entire galaxy, they were used to being arrogant. Even Beyond Grade As would not be taken seriously by them.

Since seven years ago, EsGod had been talking about trees and trees all day long. The way they saw it, EsGod's insanity had worsened again. That was why he had sent them to the Shattered Star Ring to find the coordinates of a certain wormhole.

"Harrofal has the data we want," Colin said. "He's our primary target. If we can get the data successfully, we won't have to find Black Star. No matter what, Harrofal is easier to deal with than Black Star."

Everyone nodded.

Colin paused for a moment before continuing.

"After completing the first mission, we'll go steal the Evolution Cube."

—
